summary: Cantor Equity Partners I, Inc. (CEPO) filed an 8-K announcing a postponement of its extraordinary general meeting from June 26 to July 2, 2026, to approve its proposed initial business combination with BSTR Holdings, Inc. The meeting will consider proposals to approve the business combination agreement entered into on July 16, 2025. The redemption deadline for Class A ordinary shares is extended to June 30, 2026. As a SPAC, CEPO is seeking shareholder approval for its de-SPAC transaction. Watch the shareholder vote and redemption levels, which could affect the deal's completion and post-close valuation.
